verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration and visa service that handles sensitive client data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI-model training is a fair privacy question to ask. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training policy. The general claim of "protected data security" is an adjacent control, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
